This is "容留他人吸食毒品" which under Chinese criminal law is the crime of "容留他人吸食毒品罪" (Crime of allowing others to use drugs). The statutory article is in Criminal Law, article 347? Actually article 347 is "非法提供毒品原料、制剂、工具" etc. The crime of "容留他人吸食毒品" is article 347? Let's recall: In China, "容留他人吸食毒品罪" is article 347 of the Criminal Law (since amendment). The penalty: up to 3 years, or less, etc. So the only crime directly supported is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Possibly also "非法提供场所" but that's same. So answer: [罪名]容留他人吸食毒品罪<eoa>
